w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 Night. The lingering The Redactor gorges at the treeline — 800 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Big Big is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
They come fast and scared — a family, or what's left of one. "Please. We heard you take people in." Behind them, something worse than weather.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (19/11/6), with 4 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 30 → 24 · capped · Craft 8 · Talk 17 · Explore 35 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalLabel: Stay both-hands. No merge, no champion.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE RELAY — "Stay both-hands. No merge, no champion."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Rasha Mahmoud ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
